argument_markdown:
## Exact theorem

The exact group W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{5,8};Q), equivalently W_{24}H^{24}(M_{5,8};Q)(20), is a direct sum of Q(8); a disproof must exhibit a surviving non-Tate summand in this exact group. This theorem does not conclude H^{16}(Mbar_{5,8};Q) and does not conclude the campaign boundary-image theorem.

## Source-backed inputs

FND-0001 gives, for d=3g-3+n, the Poincare identification W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{g,n};Q)=W_{2d-16}H^{2d-16}(M_{g,n};Q)(d). FND-0195 is the established CLP–Harer–CKgP peel in degree k=vcd(M_{g,n})=4g-4+n: when n-1<=c(g), with the published value c(5)=7, it proves that W_k H^k(M_{g,n};Q) is a finite direct sum of Q(-k/2). Its load-bearing ingredients are the lowest-weight restriction surjection of FND-0197, the closed-universal-curve Kunneth/psi disposal of FND-0196, strict Harer vanishings on the smaller pointed space and on M_g with local coefficients, and the published CKgP Tate range. FND-0033 supplies semisimplicity at a fixed pure weight, so the resulting subquotients are honest direct sums of the indicated Tate object.

## Specialization to (5,8)

Here d=3*5-3+8=20 and k=2d-16=24. Also vcd(M_{5,8})=4*5-4+8=24, while n-1=7=c(5). Thus FND-0195 applies at its inclusive published endpoint and yields

W_24 H^24(M_{5,8};Q) = Q(-12)^{oplus r}

for some finite r>=0.

For completeness, the numerical peel has the same strict slack at each vanishing step. The pullback term Phi_{5,8}^{24} vanishes because H^24(M_{5,7};Q)=0 and vcd(M_{5,7})=23<24. In the closed universal-curve source C^8 over M_5, every Kunneth multi-index with |i|<=8 has base degree 24-|i|>=16>vcd(M_5)=15 and therefore vanishes for its finite-dimensional rational local system. Every remaining multi-index has some slot equal to 2 and is carried, via the FND-0196 projector/induction, into the psi-generated image from W_22 H^22(M_{5,7};Q). Since 7=c(5), the published CKgP range types that source as Q(-11)^{oplus a}; multiplication by psi, of type Q(-1), makes its image a subquotient of Q(-12)^{oplus b}. The FND-0197 surjection reaches the full target, and fixed-weight semisimplicity gives the displayed direct-sum decomposition.

Finally FND-0001 gives

W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{5,8};Q)=W_24H^24(M_{5,8};Q)(20)=Q(-12)(20)^{oplus r}=Q(8)^{oplus r}.

This proves exactly the assigned theorem.

## Constraints, computations, and gaps

No finite computation or computational hypothesis is used, and there is no remaining gap. The proof does not infer vanishing from 24=vcd(M_{5,8}); FND-0035 expressly forbids that inference. The strict inequalities 24>23 and 16>15 occur only inside the established peel. No undecorated top-weight CGP/graph-complex calculation, point count, or punctured-curve forgetful Leray argument is used. In particular the mixed R^1 local-system obstruction is not renamed: the Kunneth calculation is on the proper closed universal curve C^8 over M_5. No statement about H^{16}(Mbar_{5,8};Q) or about the campaign boundary-image is made.
